trust_decision.summary: Text that users or admins control (display name, question title, answer/comment summary, tags, site name) is put into HTML email bodies through translator.TrWithData placeholders with no HTML escaping, and the result is sent as text/html. The fix escapes these fields field by field in the export EmailService template builders.

landing_point.why: The advisory names XSS in email templates. The only email template builders live here, and NewAnswerTemplate is the first one that takes user content (answer summary).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST answer API -> answer_service external notification (internal/service/content/answer_service.go:765-776) -> new_answer_notification (internal/service/notification/new_answer_notification.go:74)

question invite API -> question_service invite notification (internal/service/content/question_service.go:886-887) -> invite_answer_notification (internal/service/notification/invite_answer_notification.go:74)

POST comment API -> comment_service external notification (internal/service/comment/comment_service.go:569-577) -> new_comment_notification (internal/service/notification/new_comment_notification.go:73); also the review approval path (internal/service/review/review_service.go:502-510)
POST question API -> new question queue (internal/schema/new_question_queue_schema.go:45-49) -> new_question_notification (internal/service/notification/new_question_notification.go:180)
helper escapeEmailHTMLText used by the four builders above

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published sites are in one file (internal/service/export/email_service.go). No second implementation, wrapper or serializer is touched.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the four templates the fix did not change (register, pass reset, change email, test), SiteName is the only interpolated text and only an admin can set it, so a solver can argue 'admin is trusted, and those templates carry no user content'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
Email bodies must keep their template HTML markup (,
,
, ) and working href URLs. Escaping the whole rendered body, or escaping the URL fields, breaks the links and layout. Titles go into the plain-text Subject header and the fix leaves them unescaped; escaping them would show < entities in subjects.

O6_input_shapes: plain string fields (DisplayName, QuestionTitle, AnswerSummary, CommentSummary, SiteName)
tag list joined into one string (Tags = strings.Join(raw.Tags, ", ")), internal/service/export/email_service.go:319

O7_producer.where: Summaries come from htmltext.FetchExcerpt -> ClearText -> StripTags (pkg/htmltext/htmltext.go:53-65,153-161). SiteName is HTML-unescaped on read (internal/service/siteinfo_common/siteinfo_service.go:83). Both are upstream producers, but the fix is at the sink and does not depend on them.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RegisterTemplate body puts SiteName (HTML-unescaped on read) into the HTML body without escaping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: only an admin can set the site name, and the template has no user content
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 60 lines above the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PassResetTemplate body puts SiteName in without escaping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: only an admin can set the site name

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ChangeEmailTemplate body puts SiteName in without escaping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: only an admin can set the site name

O8_uncovered_routes.route: TestTemplate body: SiteName placeholder only in the title for en_US; body has no placeholder in en_US but other locales are unknown
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: test email that only an admin triggers

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new user-content email template (e.g. a badge-earned or mention email with a DisplayName/BadgeName field) built with TrWithData like the others
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every builder follows the same copy-paste pattern of building a struct and calling TrWithData. A maintainer adding a template would copy an unescaped one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an in-repo notification plugin or digest email that renders QuestionTitle/QuestionTags from plugin.NotificationMessage into HTML
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugin notification messages carry the same raw fields, and a second renderer in another package would be a real second implementation at distance.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored HTML injection into outbound HTML email (template placeholder output encoding)

O10_build.project_tests: No tests in internal/service/export at the pinned commit, and the fix diff adds none. Template builders can be unit-tested with a stub SiteInfoCommonService plus a loaded translator; the SMTP send can be skipped (empty SMTPHost returns early, email_service.go:129-132).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only AnswerSummary/CommentSummary in the reported template, or html.EscapeString the whole rendered body, which breaks links and markup.

out_of_scope_notes: SiteName is html.UnescapeString'd on read and in the admin update response (internal/service/siteinfo_common/siteinfo_service.go:83, internal/controller_admin/siteinfo_controller.go:294). That affects web rendering paths too; not pursued.
Answer/comment summaries pass through StripTags on ParsedText, so the fix's escaping may double-encode entities already in ParsedText (display issue, not pursued).
unverified: That GlobalTrans.TrWithData (go-i18n, external dependency) renders with text/template and so does no auto-escaping. Inferred from the provider.go:155 comment and from the fix's need to escape; the dependency source was not read.
